stage: Canonical remaster, concept and independent imported-GLB feedback reviewed

iterations.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: OpenFA Artemian Ultimate MkII AR3C heavy combat spacecraft. Input image is actual correctly paletted legacy headings0/4/12/28, PRIMARY reference for silhouette, proportions, major sections and colours. Remaster that SAME object: one very broad low elongated OVAL SILVER opaque upper cover, stretched along its fore-aft axis roughly2:1 in top plan; a visibly smaller FOREST-GREEN rounded lower body/bowl hangs beneath, recessed inward from silver cover perimeter. A narrow dark/alloy seam separates overlapping upper/lower assemblies. Small seated grey perimeter protrusions surround the lower body below the lid edge. Legacy does not establish exact count; an authored even ring of twelve modest fittings is plausible, but do NOT turn these into twelve guns or engines. Cover is continuous smooth worn silver alloy with a low convex roof, NOT a circular flying saucer, not a flat metal plate, no tall central dome/bridge, no fins, no extra pods. Preserve the visible green underbody; do not make the craft entirely grey. Pale yellow-white original highlights do NOT establish emission/windows/lamps; avoid glowing light strips or exhausts. Six equipment slots have unknown positions: no speculative equipment placement. Sparse fitted maintenance covers, tiny fasteners and recessed seams, large calm surfaces without dense panel grids. Used spacecraft metal: restrained grime near seams, scuffs, small irregular stains and dents while silhouette stays clear. Professional high-detail believable game asset concept. One consistent spacecraft shown in large elevated front-three-quarter, smaller true side view and top view, same proportions and fittings. Plain charcoal background, no text or logos.
iterations.verdict: Retained broad form/material reference: elongated silver low convex lid, recessed green lower body, modest opaque grey perimeter fittings, sparse worn alloy construction. Exact fitting count and hatch layout remain authored; no emission inferred from legacy pale marks.
iterations.gallery_label: Reviewed silver lid and green lower body concept

glb_feedback.verdict: Actual imported hero/side/end/underside views retain low elongated silver lid and green lower body, but the perimeter fittings hang as rounded bulbs. Correct their profile towards lower broad seated pads, following actual legacy/concept cues; preserve fitting roots and support connections.

Twelve fitting profiles shortened to35 percent along their outward axes and broadened to125 percent transversely about preserved roots, with inverse-transpose normal correction. Actual imported 0/4/12/28 comparison against legacy and concept inspected; low silver cover, recessed green underbody, seam and modest perimeter pads retained. 43040tri/4batches/1material,54 tested contacts,two radial dents. Exact fitting count/shape and hatch layout remain interpretation; underside is shaded by the preview lighting, so client illumination/material validation remains necessary.

Coarse projected-aspect check exposed a too-flat comparison camera. Raised estimated comparison elevation from.16 to.29 and rerendered corresponding views; did not distort the hull to compensate for a camera mismatch. This remains an estimated view, not recovered client calibration.

glb_visual_review: Actual legacy and independent GLB at estimated corresponding 0/4/12/28 angles compared with concept1. Broad elongated convex silver cover over smaller green body retained. Green underbody is readable in side/underside views but darker under preview lighting than the original; this is not solved by inventing emission. Twelve low broad fittings replace the rejected hanging bulb profile while retaining their root contacts. Actual reference side alpha bounds78x21; comparison elevation.29/azimuth180 are estimates, not recovered client calibration. Sparse wear and hatches remain authored; no dense panel grid or inferred glow.
